The production capacity planning task succeeded with a perfect verifier reward by utilizing a robust LangChain graph implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in test_output.py passed successfully in 0.15 seconds, confirming the validity of the generated capacity plan. Future iterations should maintain the current graph-based logic while refining the judge-specific criteria to bridge the gap between the 1.0 verifier score and the 0.76 judge reward.
